commands_raw:
In [color=green][b]Genome Garden[/b][/color] all living things are defined by genes makeup that defines everything about them, just like in real life.
---
We've given these genes are given names based on the primary effects they have on the plant e.g. [b]colour_1[/b] or [b]pigment[/b].
---
In the case of the [b]colour_1[/b] gene we've discovered the [color=RED][b]R[/b][/color] allele which appears to be responsible for creating a red color!"
---
In each flower, each gene is made up of two alleles. This tulip for example has two [color=RED][b]R[/b][/color] alleles for it's [b]colour_1[/b] gene. Hover over it to take a look!
signal(show_flower,red_tulip)
name: Tutorial_start

commands_raw:

When we cross-breed flowers together the child inherits one allele from each parent for each gene. Here's another tulip with [color=GOLD][code]Y[/code][/color] alleles for the [u]colour_1[/u] gene. The [color=GOLD][code]Y[/code][/color] allele is responsible or producing a [color=GOLD]yellow[/color] colour!
signal(show_flower,yellow_tulip)
